top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form through Holst (native physiology and secretion), Mojsov (identification and synthesis of the active peptide) and Drucker (peptide biology and the translational concept). The chain from mechanism to independently replicated large randomized outcome trials is complete and mature. The citation limits credit to the physiology and active-peptide concept, not to specific products. The Mojsov priority question relative to the Habener group is a real attribution uncertainty, but it concerns one slot and does not outweigh the merit of the discovery, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; documented collaboration with Thomas Perlmann and a Greengard postdoctoral period do not connect to any credited name in P001
